name: Scope
description:
You put a custom-designed scope on your runegun.
Its range is increased by 2 tiles.
When you take the Aim Technique with it the bonus increases to +3.

name: Revolving Barrel
description:
You've designed a system to allow you to load multiple bullets at once in your runegun.
Your runegun has the Magazine 3 trait, allowing you to fire three times before reloading.
The reload action still only reloads one bullet, so you need to spend 3 actions to fully reload it.

name: Agile Gunsmith
description:
You've modified your pistol to be a quick and graceful weapon.
Your runegun pistol has the Agile trait.

name: Integrated Bayonet
description:
You have integrated a bayonet into the design of your runegun.
Your runegun has a built-in bayonet, which loses the -1 attack penalty.
It can be retracted or extended from your runegun as an action.
It benefits from all the runes you apply to your runegun.

name: Bigger Booms
description:
You can increase the impact of your cannon.
When firing your runegun you can spend 5 mana to make it deal an additional die of damage.
After using this you become Off-Guard 2 until the start of your next turn or until you take an action to steady yourself.

name: Silencer
description:
You've added a sound-absorbing rune to make your runegun more subtle.
When firing your runegun you can spend 2 mana to ignore the Loud trait.

name: Mighty Blast
description:
You have modified your runegun so you can project a cone of thundering force in front of you.
When firing your runegun you can spend 4 mana to deal 1d8 thunder damage to creatures in a 3-tile cone (Fortitude save).

name: Blastback
description:
You can let the power of your weapon blast you back away from your foes.
When you strike with your runegun cannon you can choose to move back 1 tile in the direction opposite your shot.
Enemies have disadvantage on Reactive Strikes they make against this movement.

name: Fatal Bullets
description:
Your custom bullets are even more deadly than normal.
Increase the Deadly damage die of your runegun by 2 (d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12).
Your proficiency level in Crafting, Intimidation, or Survival increases (max Expert).

name: Six Shot
description:
You've enhanced your barrel capacity.
Your runegun now has the Magazine 6 trait.

name: Harness Discharged Mana
description:
You can empower your bayonet with discharged mana from the runework of your runegun.
If you make a bayonet attack as the next action after firing your runegun the attack has a +1 bonus and does an extra 1d6 damage.

name: Stabilizer
description:
When stabilized and aiming at stationary targets you almost can't miss.
If you've taken the Aim action and your target hasn't moved since last turn the bonus increases to +5.

name: Fan The Hammer
description:
You can quickly unload your bullets into a target.
You gain the Fan The Hammer activity.

name: True Deadliness
description:
One shot, one kill.
Further increase the Deadly damage die for your runegun (d8 to d10, d10 to d12, d12 to 2d8).
Your proficiency level in Crafting, Intimidation, or Survival increases (max Master)

name: Biggest Booms
description:
None can match your blasts.
When using Bigger Booms you can spend 15 mana to deal two additional dice of damage instead.

name: Magazine Reload
description:
With a complex mechanical system you can now reload your entire magazine at once.
You can spend 2 actions to reload your runegun's entire magazine.
